# Changelog

## 2026-10-18

- Specify the bounded `core-text-v1` data/text compatibility profile before
  tests: 25 named core operations, explicit LABEL/COMMENT sentinel IDs,
  ordinary identity preservation, tagged operands and canonical UTF-8/LF text.
- Add four literal positive goldens, twenty typed rejection witnesses,
  twenty-two text rejection witnesses and four generator observations.
- Add a closed structural schema and independent standard-library oracle;
  pin named witness payloads against coordinated evidence-erasure mutations.
- Test strict JSON/Unicode/integer domains, ID/shape/ordering/resource limits,
  read/CLI failures and exact canonical text. Integrate validator/tests in
  unconditional CI metadata contracts without granting native-adopter credit.
